categories.name: RUB Stablecoin
categories.content: A RUB stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Russian Ruble (RUB).

categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.

categories.name: Layer 3 (L3)
categories.content: Layer 3 protocols are built on Layer 2, enabling hosting of application-specific decentralized applications while addressing issues such as scalability, interoperability and customization.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Duck-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by duck.

categories.name: Market-Making Solution
categories.content: A Market-Making Solution refers to a service that enhances liquidity in markets by consistently offering buy and sell orders.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Olympus Pro Ecosystem
categories.content: Olympus Pro designed to provide liquidity management solutions for DeFi protocols. They offers a service called "bonds-as-a-service," which allows protocols to own their liquidity by offering discounted OHM tokens in exchange for liquidity provider (LP) tokens. This helps protocols to reduce their reliance on liquidity mining incentives and gain more control over their liquidity.

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Augmented Reality
categories.content: Augmented Reality (AR) offers interactive experiences without disconnecting users from the real world, allowing them to interact with digital elements in a real-world context.

categories.name: Clanker Ecosystem
categories.content: Clanker Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via Clanker, an autonomous memecoin launcher.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: TokenSets Ecosystem
